product_one_liner.value: Funnel helps marketing and data teams collect, prepare and analyze marketing data for reporting, marketing mix modeling and budget optimization.
product_one_liner.notes: The about page identifies marketing and data teams as the audience and describes data collection, preparation, reporting, marketing mix modeling and budget optimization.

pricing_page.notes: Funnel has a public plans-and-pricing page at https://funnel.io/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Adidas and Uber appear on Funnel's customer case-study page. | named_customers.0: Adidas appears on the customer case-study page. | named_customers.1: Uber appears on the customer case-study page.

employee_band.notes: Funnel reports more than 300 employees, supporting the 201-500 band. The published figure is approximate rather than an exact headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Stockholm location page identifies the office as Funnel's headquarters. | hq_country: Funnel's Stockholm, Sweden location page identifies the office as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Funnel's about page explicitly states that it was founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts describe how Funnel is built: developer Filips Nastins explains its declarative connector framework, and Engineering Manager Anirudh Mehta explains the semantic-query and data-platform architecture.

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base contains introductory product documentation, AI documentation, release notes and multiple MCP setup guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current jobs index lists Product Engineer - AI Product Experience and links to its posting; AI appears in the qualifying role title.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed product documentation, security and privacy material, subprocessor provisions and technical blog did not establish a model provider for Funnel's own AI product. AWS is identified as infrastructure, while named external MCP clients and internal coding tools do not establish the product's underlying model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Funnel claims SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as one of the requested compliance categories, rather than represented as an independently awarded certification. | compliance_certs.0: Funnel explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 attestation. | compliance_certs.1: Funnel explicitly states that its security program is ISO 27001 certified. | compliance_certs.2: Funnel explicitly claims GDPR compliance; this is a compliance claim rather than an independently awarded certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement describes a debt facility combining a revolving credit facility and a junior term loan, rather than an equity funding round. | funding_date: The financing announcement is dated January 28, 2026, yielding 2026-01. | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified financing announcement states an $80 million debt facility. This is the full facility size, not solely incremental capital.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 2026 debt financing falls within the preceding 18 months and provides additional capital while replacing a previous facility.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current jobs index lists only Product Engineer - AI Product Experience and Measurement Consultant - Boston, neither a qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive role. A separately accessible older SDR posting was not listed among current openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Funnel launched Digital Measurement on May 26, 2026, within the six-month window. The product combines MMM, multi-touch attribution and ad-platform signals.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown: the large people directory supplies leadership titles but not appointment dates. The available profile information was inconsistent, so an in-window arrival or departure could not be established reliably.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Funnel RevOps employee explicitly identifies HubSpot as the company's CRM and names Gong among tools used by its commercial teams. | crm_stack_signal.0: A Funnel RevOps employee identifies HubSpot as its CRM. | crm_stack_signal.1: Funnel's commercial-team discussion explicitly names Gong among the tools it uses.
